analyst.summary: Aarti Industries, a large diversified specialty and commodity chemicals manufacturer, has seen its return on capital fall sharply (from a historical high-teens level to around 7%) as debt rose to fund capacity expansion during a period of industry-wide pricing pressure from global oversupply. The last five quarters do show a steady sequential profit recovery, and FY26 overall revenue and profit both grew at double-digit rates. We rate it a Hold: a real recovery is underway, but capital efficiency has not yet caught up, and the valuation is not undemanding.
